name: Snappa
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Snappa, compose fixed-size social graphics from local images, text, and a small template set. The hard boundary is stock-photo allowance, templates, team sharing, and cloud convenience, plus editor polish, assets, collaboration, and distribution.
